Requirements: R-16
Plan row: TS-9

Obligations: OB-12.

## Given
- An integration with known non-secret credential values (for example a URL and a user name) in the source project; secret fields may be masked in GET and are not asserted.
- Its edit page open.

## When
1. P-project-change: change only the Project to the target, Save, confirm in the modal.
2. P-alias-only (control): on a second integration change only the alias, Save.
3. Read both integrations through the API.

## Then
1. P-project-change: the stored non-secret credential fields equal the values loaded before the edit, and the integration is in the target.
2. P-alias-only: the stored non-secret credential fields still equal the loaded values.

## Self-probe notes
- Discriminating input: the project change is the only edit; a credential-type auto-reset in edit mode would blank the fields (Then 1).
- Values are known from the seed, not recomputed from the form. Read-back is the API, independent of the UI.
- Masked secret fields cannot prove retention; this is a named gap, not a pass of the secret part.

## Obligation coverage
| obligation/part | oracle | boundary | Then | residual gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OB-12 credentials kept on project change | R-16 | API GET after UI save | 1, 2 | masked secret fields not provable |
